period.templateHint.semester: Suggests about 4 months from today. You can change the dates.
period.templateHint.trip: Suggests one week starting next week. You can change the dates.
period.templateHint.custom: Suggests 30 days from today. You can change the dates.
period.allocatedHint: A limit to help you organize. It doesn't move, add or reserve money.
period.deleted: Budget deleted. Its transactions are unchanged.
period.deleteNote: Deleting the budget doesn't delete or change any transaction, nor the reserve goal if you created one.
period.notMoneyText: Creating a budget doesn't create income, transfers or reserves. Your real available money only goes down if you reserve money for the period.
period.emptyText: For a semester, a trip or a season.
period.consolidated: Spent across all your periods (no duplicates)
period.consolidatedShared_one: {count} transaction is in more than one period: it counts only once.
period.consolidatedShared_other: {count} transactions are in more than one period: each counts only once.
period.overText: Spending is above the allocation. It doesn't affect your accounts: it's a heads-up to help you plan.
period.pace: To stay within it: up to {day} per day or {week} per week ({days} days left, including today).
period.paceUpcoming: Once it starts: up to {day} per day or {week} per week ({days} days).
period.endedNote: The period has ended. You can archive it: the history is kept.
period.plannedNote: There are also {amount} in linked planned expenses (not counted as spent yet).
period.explainRefunds: Refunds of a linked expense are subtracted even if you don't link them.
period.explainPace: Per day = remaining ÷ days left (today and the last day included), rounded down.
period.explainOutside: A linked transaction outside the dates still counts: you linked it on purpose.
period.explainShared: If a transaction is in two budgets, it counts in each, but only once in the combined total.
period.explainTrash: Anything in the trash doesn't count. If you restore it, it counts again.
period.availableToday: You can spend today (until your next income): {amount}
period.noReserve: You haven't reserved money for this period.
period.reserveLine: Reserved for the period: {amount} (already used by period expenses: {consumed}).
period.outsideCount_one: {count} linked transaction is dated outside the period.
period.outsideCount_other: {count} linked transactions are dated outside the period.
period.sharedCount_one: {count} transaction is also in another budget.
period.sharedCount_other: {count} transactions are also in another budget.
period.trashedCount_one: {count} linked transaction is in the trash and doesn't count.
period.trashedCount_other: {count} linked transactions are in the trash and don't count.
period.movementsHint: Check the expenses and refunds that belong to this budget. Only the link is saved: the transaction isn't copied or changed.
period.noCandidates: No expenses in these dates yet.
period.archivedToast: Budget archived. Its history is kept.
period.reserveExplain: Money is set aside from "You can spend" in a goal linked to this budget (no transaction or transfer is created). What you spend in the period gradually frees the reserve, so it's never subtracted twice.
period.reserveEffect: "You can spend" will go from {before} to {after}.
period.suggestText_one: There is {count} expense in these dates that isn't linked yet.
period.suggestText_other: There are {count} expenses in these dates that aren't linked yet.
period.suggestHint: It's only a date-based suggestion: review the list and uncheck any that don't belong. It can be undone.
period.ruleHint: When you record an expense in these categories within the dates, the form will check this period. It's only a suggestion: you can uncheck it.
period.notMoneyShort: A budget doesn’t create income or reserves.
period.movementsShort: Check what belongs to this budget; nothing is copied or changed.
period.reserveShort: Sets money aside from “You can spend” in a goal for this budget.
period.trip.toggleHelp: The trip’s currencies and their rates, written by you. While it lasts, the form suggests them and Apple Pay payments in those currencies are converted with them.
period.trip.localHelp: The one of the country you’re in: the first one the form suggests, and the one that decides whether “¥” means yen or yuan.
period.trip.rateHelp: Leave it empty if you don’t know it yet: without a rate, a payment in {currency} waits in To do. Changing it doesn’t touch what’s already recorded.
period.trip.rateError: Enter the rate as an exact number, for example {example}, or leave it empty.
period.trip.feeHelp: 0 if your card charges nothing. It’s included in the same rounding.
period.trip.title: Trip
period.trip.empty: No expenses linked to this trip yet.
period.trip.notStarted: The trip hasn’t started yet: no spending per day.
period.trip.unconverted_one: {count} payment in another currency is waiting for a rate in To do and isn’t in these figures.
period.trip.unconverted_other: {count} payments in another currency are waiting for a rate in To do and aren’t in these figures.
period.trip.how: Each expense was converted with ITS rate (the one it had when recorded) and rounded once to the cent. Refunds subtract in their currency and in {budget}. Planned items and the trash don’t count.
period.trip.bocCount_one: {count} transaction was converted with the indicative Bank of Canada rate for its date.
period.trip.bocCount_other: {count} transactions were converted with the indicative Bank of Canada rate for their date.
